title: And of course the DANCE NUMBERS! Love that Jingle Jangle and Spirited...
transcript: just finished watching Spirited on Apple TV Plus because this dropped hours earlier than I thought it was going to so Spirited is a new Christmas Carol adaptation but it's more like a Christmas Carol sequel which I think is a really fascinating approach it is a movie musical with music by Pasek and Paul and I know they are not for everyone I personally love their style of songwriting but if you don't just be aware of that it is very Pasek and Paul this movie was hilarious like laugh out loud funny it's got a lot of meta humor in it which is right up my alley there's also a lot of fun Easter eggs in this movie I also guessed the ending of this movie like 10 minutes into it but there were so many twists and turns along the way that it was absolutely worth a journey overall I had 1t of fun I would definitely watch this again if you are planning on watching this with kids just be aware that it is very peaceful g 13 there's a lot of adult humor in it it's definitely something I would have watched as a kid but just be aware it may not be for your family overall I loved it and if you're getting Apple TV just for a little bit also watch Schmigadoon cause you'll also love that if you like this
